name: Cloth-Changing Person Re-identification and Gait Recognition Benchmark (CCPG)
domain: computer vision / gait recognition / person re-identification
description: A cloth-changing benchmark containing RGB, silhouette, and pose sequences for 200 identities, with more than 16,000 indoor and outdoor sequences spanning seven clothing statuses per identity.
citation: Weijia Li, Saihui Hou, Chunjie Zhang, Chunshui Cao, Xu Liu, Yongzhen Huang, and Yao Zhao. An In-Depth Exploration of Person Re-Identification and Gait Recognition in Cloth-Changing Conditions. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2023, pp. 13824-13833.

license.notes: License is unverified; dataset access requires a signed usage agreement and is restricted to academic use, but no standard license identifier is published.
